verdict.rationale: CIPO is a government intellectual-property office whose core product is the official filing, examination and registry service. Running that statutory registry on your own infrastructure is a category error, not a missing feature. The downloadable bulk data and database search are data access, not a self-hostable product, so they do not make the self-hosting axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
